item: R826 stage 3b: per-article segment schema derived from the models, batch insert with shared references checked in code, existing-only segment opens
summary: Segment tables and indexes are compiled from the app's models, HOT_INDEXES and the two search-index DDLs, never typed; foreign keys to the shared file are dropped and listed in SHARED_REFERENCES (pinned against the models), enforced by check_shared_references, which refuses a missing or uncommitted shared row and writes nothing. The writer re-reads schema_version per transaction. Segment opens never create: lstat (regular, one name), mode=rw, identity re-checked; the link-swap and hot-journal residual is stated and is a stage 4 condition with segment-aware deletes. Writes stay off.
